# Erdos.p142 — Erdős problem 142

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/142
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/142.lean`, theorem `erdos_142.variants.lower`, AMS 11).

Show that $r_k(N) = o_k(N / \log N)$, where $r_k(N)$ the largest possible size of a subset
of $\{1, \dots, N\}$ that does not contain any non-trivial $k$-term arithmetic progression.

## Statement
∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 < k), (fun N => (r k N : ℝ)) =o[atTop] (fun N : ℕ => N / (N : ℝ).log)

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
